fusions.name: Spawning Tide
fusions.desc: Releases spawn that deals 28 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts, hitting every enemy within 3.5 tiles for 80% of that. Its damage rises 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles of you (max 32%).

fusions.name: Calcify
fusions.desc: A touch with the rod that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and leaves it [Stalled] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Reef Seat
fusions.desc: Plants a coral seat that stands for 15 seconds and strikes an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Accreted Edicts
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 8. When you reach 8, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (34% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
